title: test(plugin-security): split the three slow delegated boundary cases one it per table over a shared boot
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBGfjh4tRJunWedNNenQ78iY)_

Fixes #32238

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:plugin-security 组织管理员分配边界测试文件里,三组最慢的「委派管理员」用例按两张分配表各拆成一个用例,同一组内共用一次引擎启动与播种。
- 为什么改:'single' 那条用例在合并队列的 Test Core 分片上跑了 5249 ms,超过 vitest 默认 5 秒被判失败,把无关 PR 踢出队列。
- 风险与回滚:只动一个测试文件,不发布;每条断言原样保留,操作顺序与拆分前完全一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts` 的 `sharedDelegationBoot` 和三处按表拆分的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`,预期 92 个全过,拆分后的用例各在 200 ms 左右。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One test file only. Three delegated-branch cases each looped over both assignment tables on a fresh boot:

- `update and delete of a row the caller cannot read …` (postures `group`, `isolated`)
- `control: a row it reads keeps its verdict and its guidance …` (postures `group`, `isolated`)
- `control, 'single': a row of another organization that a delegate reads …` (the case that timed out)

Each is now a `describe` with one `it` per table (and, for the `control: a row it reads` pair, a third `it` for the hidden-position tail). The `it`s of one `describe` share one booted, delegation-seeded engine (`sharedDelegationBoot`, set up in `beforeAll`, destroyed in `afterAll`, taken off the per-case teardown list).

Why the shared boot is safe here, per the ruling's isolation bar:

- The `it`s run in file order, so the shared engine sees exactly the operations the one case ran before, in the same order.
- Each table's writes name ids of their own (`unreadable_TABLE`, `readable_TABLE`, `in_scope_CALLER_TABLE`, `out_of_scope_TABLE`, `hidden_out`), and every assertion reads by those ids.
- The in-scope holder each write uses is the same one as before: the running `holder` counter that spanned the tables is now a per-table offset (2 per table for the `control` pair, 3 per table for the `'single'` control; the hidden tail takes holder 4, as before).
- Order independence was checked too: the file passes with `--sequence.shuffle`, and each second-table case passes alone (`-t 'sys_user_permission_set$'`, 5 passed, 87 skipped), with the first table never run.

The per-case teardown restores every spy, so the helper re-quiets the engine's `warn` in each case, as `boot` does.

The `// test-budget:` header: number unchanged (20; the CI basis is not re-measured here), the reason now says which cases share a boot, and the local reading is updated from this measurement.

## Tests

Every moved case keeps every assertion it had:

- `update and delete of a row the caller cannot read …`: per table, the row exists; for each of the three delegates and both targets, the read-door precondition and the whole answer for update and delete; the row is untouched. Same assertions, one `it` per table.
- `control: a row it reads …`: per table, both callers read, update and delete the in-scope row (200, then gone); the out-of-scope row is refused with one caller read, the scope guidance, and an answer unlike the no-row answer, and stays. The hidden-position tail: read without the position, refused for update and delete without naming a hidden value, row stays. Same assertions.
- `control, 'single' …`: per table, both callers read the other organization's row and are refused with its guidance, row stays; each of the three delegates' in-scope writes lands with one caller read, or is refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` for the write-only grant, and the stored row count matches. Same assertions.

No assertion dropped, no timeout raised, nothing skipped.

## Acceptance notes

- Step 0 says the time is volume, not a product path: boot about 30% of the case, the delegation seed about 25%, the body the rest at roughly 13 ms per engine call. Nothing in `SecurityPlugin.start` or the engine stands out, so no product finding.
- Not changed: the three `posture X: a column the caller's field rules hide …` cases (578 to 799 ms locally) run under their own explicit 9 s budget, sized at 3x their slowest Test Core reading, so they do not sit on the 5 s default. The `partially masked column` case (458 ms) is one boot plus one delegation seed plus six writes on its own masking-rule boot, which it cannot share.
- The re-judged header claim: "no boot can be shared" still holds for every case that writes and then asserts on rows a sibling also touches; it does not hold for the per-table halves of one case, which is what this PR shares.

## Verification

<details><summary>Step 0: boot vs body, local (shared 4-core box)</summary>

Measured with a temporary instrumented copy of the file (deleted after the run).

| case | total | boot | delegation seed | body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| control, 'single' (the timed-out case) | 648 ms | 178 ms | 147 ms | 323 ms |
| control: a row it reads (group) | 661 ms | 162 ms | 167 ms | 332 ms |
| control: a row it reads (isolated) | 615 ms | 169 ms | 161 ms | 285 ms |
| cannot read (group) | 574 ms | 156 ms | 167 ms | 251 ms |
| cannot read (isolated) | 518 ms | 129 ms | 133 ms | 256 ms |

85 boots, mean 119 ms. The CI shard ran the `'single'` case at 5249 ms, about 8x the local reading.
</details>

<details><summary>After: per-case readings, local</summary>

| split case | sys_user_position | sys_user_permission_set | hidden tail |
|---|---|---|---|
| cannot read (group) | 130 ms | 119 ms | |
| cannot read (isolated) | 105 ms | 97 ms | |
| control: a row it reads (group) | 120 ms | 198 ms | 26 ms |
| control: a row it reads (isolated) | 125 ms | 190 ms | 26 ms |
| control, 'single' | 129 ms | 185 ms | |

Before, the same five cases took 518 to 749 ms. Slowest case in the file on the 5 s default is now 458 ms (the masked-column case, untouched); the bound of 2 s per case locally holds for every case. File: 92/92 passed, 17.5 s wall (18.2 s before). The shared `beforeAll` (boot plus seed, about 320 ms locally) runs under vitest's 10 s hook timeout. The Test Core shard reading comes from this PR's CI.
</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 53 families; all 53 run locally, exit 0 (`--ran`: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). Three first exited 3 on prerequisites (pinned fixture commit not fetched; plugin-security `dist` not yet built) and passed once those were in place.
</details>

`@objectstack/plugin-security` publishes `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security build`: `sharedDelegationBoot` 0 hits and the file name 0 hits across those paths; positive control `class SecurityPlugin` 2 hits in `dist`. The test file does not ship, so no changeset.
